province_types.rules: Accessible only by Armies. Support can be given from or to adjacent land provinces.
Accessible only by Fleets. Cannot contain a supply center. Armies can only cross via Convoy.
Accessible by both Armies and Fleets. Fleets must track specific coastlines if a province possesses multiple distinct coasts.

special_navigation_nodes.rule: Acts as a canal. Fleets can enter from the Helgoland Bight (North Sea side) and exit directly into the Baltic Sea without treating them as distinct split coasts.
Acts as a canal bridge. Fleets can enter from the Aegean Sea and move directly into the Black Sea without encountering split coasts.
A fleet entering Bulgaria (East Coast) from the Black Sea cannot move directly into the Aegean Sea on its next turn; it must follow its assigned coast or pass through Constantinople.
Fleets must declare which coast they occupy upon entry. Armies ignore coast variations entirely.
A fleet entering from the Barents Sea docks at the North Coast; a fleet entering from the Gulf of Bothnia docks at the South Coast. They cannot cross overland to the other coast.

negotiation.mechanic: Asynchronous communication loop. Players create private text channels or voice sessions. No server-side constraint on promises.

order_submission.mechanic: Secret, blind submission. Players write exact target syntaxes for all owned units before a universal timer expires.
order_submission.timeout_fallback: All units default to HOLD orders.

resolution.mechanic: Simultaneous execution via adjudication engine. Evaluates movement conflicts, support chains, and cuts.

retreats.mechanic: Triggered only if units were dislodged during the Resolution phase.
retreats.valid_targets: Adjacent, vacant provinces not involved in a standoff/bounce during the current turn.
retreats.fallback: If no valid retreat province exists or if no order is sent, the unit is immediately disbanded.

winter_adjustment.mechanic: Triggered exclusively after Fall Retreats to realign unit count with controlled supply centers.
winter_adjustment.ownership_trigger: A supply center shifts ownership to a player if and only if their unit occupies it during the Fall phase.

actions.build: If units < supply_centers, player can spawn new units in vacant, controlled Home centers.
actions.disband: If units > supply_centers, player must select which units to remove from the board.

HOLD.logic: Unit remains in its current province and defends its position with a base strength of 1.

MOVE.logic: Unit attempts to move to an adjacent province. Succeeds if attacking strength exceeds defending strength and any competing entry strength.

SUPPORT_HOLD.logic: Adds +1 defensive strength to the target unit in its current position. Can cross province types if the supporting unit could legally move into the target's province.

SUPPORT_MOVE.logic: Adds +1 attacking strength to the target unit's offensive. The supporting unit must be legally capable of moving into the destination province itself.

CONVOY.logic: Allows an Army to travel across consecutive sea provinces occupied by convoying Fleets. If any fleet in the chain is dislodged, the entire convoy fails.

conflict_resolution_cases.standoff_or_bounce: If two or more units move to the same province with equal strength, none move. The province remains vacant.
conflict_resolution_cases.support_cut: If a unit giving support is attacked by an external province, its support is canceled (cut), and its strength contribution drops to 0. Support cannot be cut by an attack originating from the very province where the support is being directed.
conflict_resolution_cases.dislodgement: A unit is dislodged if a moving enemy unit targets its province with a total modified attack strength greater than the occupying unit's total modified defensive strength.
conflict_resolution_cases.friendly_fire_immunity: A player cannot dislodge or cut the support of their own units.
